newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Jurong Engineering opens Vietnam plant.
newsitem.headline: Jurong Engineering opens Vietnam plant.

text.p: Jurong Engineering Ltd (JEL) said on Thursday its new fabrication shop in Vietnam is expected to achieve its sales target of US$12 million in the first year.
It said in a statement turnover for steel fabrication should rise to US$20 million within the next five years.
The plant in Haiphong, about 100 km from Hanoi, was opened on July 10 and marks the completion of the first phase of the two-phase development.
The shop is owned by joint venture company, Song Da-Jurong Construction Co Ltd, in which JEL holds a 70 percent stake.
